svg.title: Grow Period A environment
svg.desc: Temperature, humidity and soil moisture over Grow Period A with limit and optimal bands.
svg.text: Grow Period A: the greenhouse as the agent saw it
Half-hour means, 9/30 20:30 to 10/14 24:00. Gray band: limits (behaviors act outside it). Blue band: optimal (they stop inside it).
Soil moisture (sensor units, mean of 2 sensors)
